title: Macular Degeneration Test
summary: Central details, visual traps and important AMD warning signs in one quick challenge.

landing.intro: Can you spot the central details and identify the warning signs? These 10 quick checks get harder - but only an eye professional can assess your vision.

about.body:
This ten-question challenge combines five on-screen visual puzzles with five general-awareness questions about age-related macular degeneration (AMD). It measures answers to this quiz, not eye health or the likelihood of disease.

Screen size, brightness, contrast, eyesight, corrective lenses, fatigue and device settings can all affect performance. New wavy or distorted lines, a new blurred or blank area in central vision, or sudden worsening should be discussed promptly with a qualified eye-care professional.

howToPlay.title: How to Play
steps: Complete five central-detail and visual-memory challenges.
Answer five questions about AMD and when to seek help.
Reveal your score, then unlock every answer you missed.

about.disclaimer: For entertainment and general learning only. This is not an Amsler-grid assessment, eye examination, medical screening tool or diagnosis. It cannot confirm or rule out macular degeneration or any other eye condition.

stage-1.preAdCopy: Your ten answers have been checked and your central-vision challenge score is ready to reveal.

profile-1.title: The Central-Detail Standout
profile-1.copy: You caught almost every visual trap and understood the key AMD facts. This is an excellent quiz score, not a medical finding.

profile-2.title: The Focused Observer
profile-2.copy: You cleared the challenge with sharp central-detail attention and strong awareness. One carefully hidden clue may have prevented perfection.

profile-3.title: The Detail Detective
profile-3.copy: You handled several close visual comparisons and important warning-sign questions well. A screen quiz cannot measure retinal health.

profile-4.title: A Tricky Visual Round
profile-4.copy: The close matches and short memory sequence made this challenging. Display settings and many everyday factors can change performance.

profile-5.title: The Visual Traps Won
profile-5.copy: Several small differences slipped through this time. This result cannot indicate macular degeneration or replace a professional eye assessment.

score.disclaimer: This entertainment score cannot diagnose or rule out macular degeneration. Seek qualified eye-care advice for new or worsening changes.
